scope: Retrospective health-and-income change model for the frozen ladder/GDP cohort. User-requested additional-data extension beyond PR23's exact-input rule: same outcomes and same 100-country cohort, but not the same inputs. No causal or blinded-validation claim.

sources.additionalIndicator: SP.DYN.LE00.IN: period life expectancy at birth, total sexes, years. This is NOT WHO healthy life expectancy and NOT a ladder score.
sources.healthFetch: Official World Bank v2 API, source=2, date=2015:2018, format=json only. Save raw response, URL, timestamp, lastupdated, SHA256, row counts and verified date range. Metadata-only indicator query permitted. No actual 2019–2025 feature request or use.

outcomes.wellbeing: Original pinned annual WHR Cantril ladder on 0–10 scale
outcomes.gdp: Original pinned World Bank real GDP per person, constant-2015 USD

cohort: Exactly original origin.json's 100 countries and order; retain all 28 original exclusions unchanged in cohort.json. Training uses original 101 background-country IDs and valid paired ladder/GDP rows, never future availability. No missing health value can remove an original training pair or forecast country.

fit.method: Ridge first-difference regression with no intercept and train-only RMS scaling, plus fixed damped forecasts of the two covariates
fit.trainingRows: Consecutive-year pairs with both ladder and GDP observed in both years and original training background country; target dy=ladder_t-ladder_(t-1); xg=ln(gdp_t)-ln(gdp_(t-1)); xh=LE_t-LE_(t-1) if both health values valid, otherwise xh=0 with missingness flag. Only years within the fit cutoff enter pairs.
fit.normalization: For each training fold, s_j=sqrt(mean(x_j^2)); replace s_j=0 with 1. Divide x by s, without centering, so zero predicted feature change implies zero ladder change. Fit these scales only from that fold's training pairs; no validation rows or future health values.
equations: beta minimizes (1/n)*sum((dy-beta_g*xg/sg-beta_h*xh/sh)^2)+lambda*(beta_g^2+beta_h^2). Solve the 2x2 penalized normal equations; no intercept, sign restriction or additional feature.

For a forecast origin t0, fit country OLS slopes on all valid 2015..t0 observations separately for ln(GDP) and LE, using year as predictor. Require at least two distinct observed years, otherwise slope=0. For health also require observed valid LE at t0, otherwise health slope and all forecast health changes=0; no imputed health level is invented.

S(h)=sum(k=1..h,0.8^k). Forecast ln(GDP_(t0+h))=ln(GDP_t0)+b_g*S(h); GDP=exp(this). Forecast LE_(t0+h)=clamp(LE_t0+b_h*S(h),0,120) when origin health exists; save raw forecast and health bound counts. Missing origin health means health change=0.
Raw ladder_(t0+h)=ladder_t0+beta_g*(ln(GDP_hat)-ln(GDP_t0))/sg+beta_h*(LE_hat-LE_t0)/sh. Final ladder=clamp(raw,0,10); save raw values and bound counts.
fittedQuantities: Country pre-origin log-GDP and LE slopes/origin health values
Selected lambda from registered internal folds
fit.futureCovariates: Only the registered damped forecasts from histories through the applicable origin; never observed 2019–2025 income or health.
fit.selection: Pool equally weighted country-horizon ladder absolute errors over both registered folds; select smallest MAE; ties within 1e-12 select largest lambda (most shrinkage). No other selection, smoothing, recentering, winsorization or calibration.

internalValidation.rules: At each fold, only original background countries with valid ladder/GDP at that fold origin get predictions; missing health still uses fallback. Fit all regression/scales/covariate slopes strictly through fold origin. Score ladder and GDP on their observed target masks; actual future health is never used. Preserve skipped origin IDs/reasons and missing target rows. Country reuse is intentional for forecasting these same countries, not independent-country validation.
internalValidation.limits: Only four annual training years and one/two-year internal horizons. Internal 2018 appears under two origins and is not independent. This cannot establish seven-year forecasting skill.

missingness: No health-driven country deletion. Missing paired health change becomes zero; missing origin health or inadequate trend history yields no health trend. Ladder/GDP training pairs require observed outcomes; no invented target values. Retain all origin countries irrespective of future availability; score observed outcomes independently on identical model/persistence masks.
baseline: Persistence of each country's 2018 ladder and GDP, identical masks
primaryMetric: 2025 endpoint ladder MAE in points, plus model-minus-persistence difference
secondaryMetrics: Pooled country-year and every horizon 2019–2025 ladder MAE/RMSE/bias with denominators
GDP cumulative-growth error percentage points relative to origin GDP, same original scorer
Origin-income quartiles: sort(GDP,id), floor(index*4/N); same fixed100-country denominator
predictionSchema: predictions.json {rows:[{id,name,year,horizon,ladder,gdp,originLadder,originGdp}]} with exactly700 rows; all finite, GDP positive
emptyOrUndefinedMetrics: null with reason; never zero success
vintageLimit: Current-vintage historical World Bank health observations can be revised, modeled or interpolated, and could have been published after their nominal year. This is not an archive of 2018-available inputs. WHR's healthy-life-expectancy predictor differs from this life-expectancy proxy; retrospective explanation is not prospective forecast skill.
exposureDisclosure: The model and complete candidate grid were registered at 6c6cdb2 before new health retrieval. A later web.find request for a health variable definition in WHR2025 unexpectedly returned broad excerpts containing contemporary fitted coefficients, several ladder-ranking values and2021HALE country values. These were not requested as data, but exposure occurred; this is not a blinded exercise. No equations, parameters or candidates changed in response; selection remains mechanical on pre2019 internal folds only. Earlier WHO definition search also surfaced global aggregate2000–2021 longevity/HALE trends. No API post-origin observations were retrieved. Distinct1960–1980 objective numeric artifacts froze at af07c67 before the WHR country/coefficient exposure and before this health retrieval; none enter the short model.
integrityGates: Commit protocol before new health-data retrieval, fitting or validation
Reject all source observation years outside2015–2018
Fold-tail perturbation cannot affect fit or covariate forecasts
One external scoring invocation after all five methods and objective entry freeze
Publish every result; no post-score refitting or future-conditioned feature use
Production defaults and old holdout artifacts unchanged

amendments.change: Record unsolicited WHR search-result excerpts; no model, candidate, cohort or metric change.
